title: Right clicking errors in debugger loses focus if using external code editor.
body:
### Tested versions

Godot v4.6.stable
Godot v4.6.1rc1

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9174) - AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 63.14 GiB memory

### Issue description

If you are using an external code editor and you right click an unfocused error in the debugger the context menu will open, then the external editor will switch to that part of the code and the context menu will close. The second time you right click the error it will work as expected. 

This doesn't happen with the built-in code editor. 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f57bdd83-c571-40aa-be17-ea08b3e7a75d

If you are working on a single display this is frustrating as the code editor pops up in front and you have to switch back to the godot window and right click again. 
I would think the appropriate fix would be to NOT goto line on right click when using an external editor rather than fighting different OS APIs or different IDE behaviors. 

### Steps to reproduce

Setup external editor. 
Make sure you haven't clicked any errors in the debugger.
Right click an error that has an associated file/line number in the debugger. 

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Play the project and right click the `GDScript::reload: The parameter "delta"...` warning. 
[MRP_RightClickContextMenuDebugger.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25142791/MRP_RightClickContextMenuDebugger.zip)
